# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our standard

We want participation in this project to be respectful, technical, and constructive. Contributors and maintainers are expected to communicate in good faith, focus criticism on ideas and code, and make room for people with different levels of experience and different backgrounds.

Examples of acceptable behavior include providing actionable review feedback, acknowledging mistakes, respecting boundaries, and keeping technical disagreements focused on evidence.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, deliberate intimidation, doxxing, sexualized attention, or repeated disruption of project collaboration.

## Scope

This code applies in repository issues, pull requests, discussions, review comments, project-related communication, and public spaces where someone is representing this project.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to `i.am@dangkhoa.dev`. Reports will be reviewed as confidentially as practical. Maintainers may edit or remove content, issue warnings, limit participation, or permanently ban participants when necessary to protect the project community.

Retaliation against a person who reports a concern in good faith is not acceptable.
